name: binnacle
description: The binnacle plugin, shipped inside the Binnacle CLI package so that its skills match the binn that serves their tools (ADR-0027).

plugins.name: binnacle
plugins.description: Binnacle's Product actions and status, driven through the binnacle MCP server, and audit, init, daemon, register and dashboard, which run binn and need no daemon to be started; dashboard keeps its token out of the chat; help is a plain guide to all of them in the user's language.

plugins.name: binnacle-mod
plugins.description: Optional: Binnacle's state beside the chat in Claude Code, read from the binnacle MCP server. It writes nothing, and shows nothing without the daemon (ADR-0047).
